clips.title: The story
paras: In Darkshire, the Scarlet Raven Tavern is the town’s primary inn and social center. Tavernkeep Smitts welcomes beleaguered locals, passing adventurers, and frightened travelers seeking shelter from the horrors beyond town.

At the Scarlet Raven Tavern, the hearth burns in the heart of Darkshire as eternal dusk hangs over the forest. Years ago, it was a busy stop where Marshal Haggard and the Stormwind Guard shared pints after patrols. Since then, business has withered alongside the town’s security. Tavernkeep Smitts tends the bar for a somber, anxious crowd huddled against cold and fear. The inn remains a crossroads for rumors and a starting point for travelers seeking answers to the dark phenomena consuming the region.
